# upstream_file_or_symbol: sklearn/tree/_tree.pyx::BestFirstTreeBuilder
notes: sklearn's `max_leaf_nodes`, `:374-508`. ADDED AS A ROW 2026-09-01: it was refused at `estimator.mojo` and named in no file, which is the state this file's header calls worse than a refusal. A REAL DEBT and not a permanent refusal -- the earlier wording, that sklearn and cuML "are different algorithms so accepting the name would be accepting a different model", argued only that we cannot map the name onto cuML's `max_leaves`. That is still true and it is not a reason to leave the capability out. WHAT IT IS. `max_leaf_nodes` selects a DIFFERENT BUILDER, not a different parameter: the frontier is a `vector[FrontierRecord]` kept as a heap, popped by highest `improvement` (`:454-455`, `_compare_records` `:359-363`), the budget spent one pop at a time (`:424`, `:503`), and a node is SEARCHED WHEN IT IS ADDED to the frontier (`_add_split_node`, defined `:562`, called at `:439`, `:509` and `:531`, with `_add_to_frontier` `:365-372`) because its gain is what orders it. WHAT IT COSTS HERE, stated so the next session does not re-derive it. (a) This builder pops a FIFO batch, searches the whole batch in one launch and pushes; best-first can expand at most ONE node per tree per launch, so the batch width collapses from `max_batch_size` to the number of in-flight trees. DEVIATION 211's cross-tree batching is what keeps that from being one launch per node, and it survives; the per-tree depth-many launches become leaves-many. (b) The search has to move from pop time to push time, so the level cycle is a second loop shape over the same kernels, not a new kernel. (c) The heap needs a DETERMINISTIC tie break, which sklearn does not have to supply and this library does: `(tree_id, node_id)` under an equal key, in the shape DEVIATION 194 already uses for `colid` then `quesval`. NOT AVAILABLE FROM THE LOSSGUIDE LANE, checked rather than assumed: `gbdt/methods/greedy_subsets_searcher/greedy_search_helper_lossguide.mojo` is a CatBoost port that argmins over `TPointsSubsets` leaf scores on a histogram tree, a representation this histogram-free directory does not have; it is a different learner's frontier, not a component. cuML's OWN leaf budget, `max_leaves`, is a separate and much weaker guarantee and IS honoured under its own name since 2026-09-01 (`ExtraTreesConfig.max_leaves` -> `builder.cuh:89`, `:106`); it is not this row.
